lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns (adoption redesign), sign-in hints (sign_in hint), home waiting info (home wait_info), and home notifications (home notification) were helpful, each producing winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
Finish screen hints (finish hint), home redesigns (home redesign), and home hints (home hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but were too low for several surprising winning layout and hint changes.

candidates.title: Grid layout redesign for adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a grid layout to present pet details, name input, and certificate preview in a balanced grid format.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns have shown strong positive results in previous tests, and grid layouts provide clear visual structure before completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet's profile and confirm adoption to bring them to your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen using a grid layout while preserving the official certificate job and messaging.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have a strong historical record (+2.5% across 13 tests), though adoption drop-off is relatively low (7.4%).

candidates.title: Starter accessory selection step insertion
candidates.change: Insert a new starter accessory selection screen right before the adoption certificate step so users can customize their pet with a starter item.
candidates.why: Adding customized setup steps during adoption increases investment and completion rates during pet adoption.

new_accessory_selection.headline: Choose a Starter Accessory
new_accessory_selection.body: Pick an accessory for your desktop pet companion.

guard.reason: Inserts a new accessory selection screen into the onboarding flow while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens or flow steps consistently hurt conversion in historical tests.

candidates.title: Desktop rendering breakdown status on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display explicit status updates on desktop rendering initialization and overlay preparation on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait_info additions previously improved conversion, and 3 support emails reported pets failing to display on desktop after onboarding.

waiting.hint: Initializing desktop graphics context and desktop overlay rendering engine...

guard.reason: The waiting screen hint replaces the indication that the pet is being made with technical graphics engine context.

candidates.title: Desktop spawn chime notification toggle on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an audio alert notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get an audible chime when their pet spawns.
candidates.why: Home notifications have proven effective, and users often switch windows while waiting for pet initialization (median wait time is 201s).

waiting.hint: Play a soft chime when your pet arrives on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a chime notification option to the waiting screen, which is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications are proven winners (+2.6%) and directly address the long 201s median wait time on the home screen.

candidates.title: Account email match guidance hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign in with their existing account email to prevent pet reset.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making this the top account complaint.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with the email used previously to automatically restore your existing desktop pet.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: List layout redesign for friend selection screen
candidates.change: Switch the pet selection screen to a clean vertical list layout highlighting each pet's unique traits and animations.
candidates.why: Adoption screen redesigns have consistently been effective in driving conversions through the adoption funnel.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet companion from the available options below.

guard.reason: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a list format while maintaining its core function of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption screen redesigns consistently yield positive results (+2.5% lift across 13 tests).

candidates.title: Pet personality selection screen insertion
candidates.change: Add a pet personality selection screen before photo upload where users select their pet's demeanor (playful, calm, or energetic).
candidates.why: Adding custom choices during pet creation deepens user connection and reduces abandonment during the 89-second adoption stage.

new_pet_personality.headline: Select Pet Personality
new_pet_personality.body: Choose how your pet companion behaves on your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserts a new pet personality screen into onboarding without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Inserting new screens during onboarding consistently damages completion rates across past tests.

candidates.title: Browser authentication popup fallback hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a troubleshooting hint below the sign-in options explaining how to unblock sign-in popups if the screen stalls.
candidates.why: Support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to open, causing drop-offs at the sign-in step.

sign_in.hint: If the sign-in window does not appear, check your web browser popup blocker settings.

guard.reason: Adds a troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen to help unblock popup authentication.

candidates.score_note: Strongly supported by both support ticket reports of stalling popups and sign-in drop-off (13.7%), paired with proven sign-in hint performance.

candidates.title: Graphics system initialization status list on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add a graphical preparation checklist component to the waiting screen detailing window overlay and sprite loading progress.
candidates.why: Providing detailed wait info during home waiting reduces perceived wait times (mean time 2336s) and improves completion.

guard.reason: Adds a progress checklist component to the waiting screen as allowed customization.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes have a proven track record (+2.1% across 5 tests) and address long waiting times.

candidates.title: Cloud save badge incentive on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Display a prominent cloud save badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing automated pet backup upon sign-in.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops 13.7% of users; highlighting automatic cloud pet backup encourages sign-in completion.

sign_in.body: Sign in to enable automatic cloud backup for your desktop pet and accessories.

guard.reason: Adds a cloud save informational badge to the sign-in screen without violating fair design or pricing rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in incentive targeted at 13.7% drop-off step, but evidence relies on a single prior test.
